description: RETN - Référentiel Éolien Terrestre National - Carte des éoliennes en service au sein de la France Métropolitaine (Hors Corse) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Aurélien TABARAUD. Retn, Éolien Terrestre National Referral, Map of wind turbines in service in metropolitan France (excluding Corsica) Data source: DREAL + DRIEE Date of Last Update: Variable by region but around the end of 2020 Content of the dataset: Positions of wind turbines in service within Metropolitan France (excluding Corsica) Attributes: Many descriptive attributes ... Coverage: Aurélien TABARAUD. The portal shows the English title as "Retn — Éolien Terrestre National Referral — Map of wind turbines in service in Metropolitan France (Hors Corsica)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Aurélien TABARAUD. Its keywords include retn, eolienne, driee, carte, wind, turbine. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2021-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
